description: One-person business without permanent employees. All roles are covered by one person.
typical_challenges: Forced all-rounder: marketing, sales, delivery, admin in one person
Capacity limit: scaling only through more of your own working hours
Acquisition vs. delivery: either find clients OR do project work
Isolated: no colleagues for feedback, brainstorming, motivation
Price pressure: often competing with larger agencies
Cash flow: no reserves for investments
Admin overhead: managing bookkeeping, taxes, insurance yourself
focus_priorities: Marketing efficiency (little time = get the maximum out of it)
Tools that work IMMEDIATELY (no training overhead)
No dependency on expensive service providers
ROI must be clear and fast
recommended_instead: All-in-one tools instead of a tool zoo
Community support instead of expensive support

budget_realistic.opex_note: Every euro is weighed three times
budget_realistic.hidden_costs: Own time for setup, learning curve, maintenance

decision_criteria: ROI must be clearly visible (ideally a calculator)
Scalable when the business grows (no repurchase)

quick_win_criteria.note: More than 15h/month is unrealistic for solo

tool_selection_preferences: Monthly cancellation instead of annual subscription
Integrations with standard tools (Gmail, Google Calendar, etc.)
success_patterns: Find a niche instead of being a generalist

typical_stundensatz.note: Large variance depending on industry and region
